name: Dareka Tasukete! Crazy de Psycho na Josou Danshi ni Owareteimasu!
original_name: 誰か助けて！クレイジーでサイコな女装男子に追われています！
source:
--Suzuka Ichigo, a yakuza underling, has a problem.
His problem is Hanyuu Momotarou, AKA "Momo-tan", a crossdressing boy who fell in love with him and began to stalk him!

As cute♪ and lovely★ as he may be, Momo-tan is a crazy, psycho and dangerous person that Ichigo needs to get away from ASAP!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17136]Freem![/url]]
